detail.title: State Continuity and Governance in WAKE
detail.summary: This journal entry addresses the requirement to maintain active projects within capacity constraints by parking one project and focusing on governance and state continuity. The research focuses on how WAKE achieves accountability across isolated model invocations through governance mechanisms and record-based state management.
